title: 한 발
suno_analysis_sp: Pop-punk with high-gain distorted electric guitars and aggressive male vocals. The track features a driving drum kit with a heavy emphasis on crash cymbals and a fast-paced snare backbeat. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar power chords in a steady eighth-note rhythm. The arrangement includes a palm-muted guitar intro that transitions into a full-band wall of sound. The vocals are delivered with a melodic but gritty punk-rock belt. Tempo is 175 BPM in the key of E Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[palm-muted distorted electric guitar riff]
[drum fill with snare and toms]
[full band enters with power chords and crash cymbals]
HEY!

[Verse 1]
[distorted guitar, driving drums, bass guitar]
교복 단추가 걸려
손끝이 차가워
3년 묵은 냄새
복도에서 번져
뒤로 교가가 울려
졸업장은 구겨졌어
친구들은 뛰어 나갔어
나만 교문 앞이야
발바닥이 안 떨어져

[Chorus]
[heavy power chords, energetic drum beat]
한 발이면 돼
그 한 발이 무거워
